events.text: German troops reached the suburbs of Warsaw and tried to enter the city but were beaten back. The Siege of Warsaw began.
The Polish Army conducted a successful delaying action in the Battle of Wola Cyrusowa.
Ciepielów massacre: German soldiers massacred some 300 Polish prisoners of war near the village of Ciepielów (see German atrocities committed against Polish prisoners of war).

links.title: German atrocities committed against Polish prisoners of war

events.text: President Roosevelt declared a limited national emergency. Increases were ordered in the enlisted strength of the army, navy and National Guard. Also, a $500,000 fund was allocated to assist in the return of American citizens stranded in war zones.
